title: BODY / FIT
purpose: Manage body-addressed fittings and source-distinct sensor observations over the shared BODY PLAN substrate without turning BODY into a diagnosis dashboard or HOUSE into body authority.
kernel: BODY_ADDRESS -> FIT -> SENSE -> ALIGN -> PROJECT -> RETURN

authority_split.body_fit: fitting identity/revision, body attachment address, local sensor-observation ledger and fusion projection
authority_split.open_twin: higher-resolution anatomical donor projection; personal registration remains an evidence obligation

fitting.law: revision creates a new fitting record with replaces/superseded_by; previous records are not overwritten

fusion.method: time-align observations by observed_property within a user-selected window; preserve one row per source
